quotes.excerpt: Dillon has no fear of Stephen Curry or any of the LeBron James, you name it.
quotes.quote: He was a good student, he was a hard worker, he was polite, he was respectful. You know, and then you see him on the court and he's that gritty guy. I'm a nice guy now, but you see me coach, I'm nuts. I'm a motherfucker for sure. Dillon has no fear in the NBA of any player. quotes.speaker: Dillon Brooks
quotes.summary_phrase: Dillon Brooks on creating the Dillon Brooks Cup
quotes.excerpt: One of the things is the Dillon Brooks Cup for aspiring basketball players, young basketball players.
quotes.quote: One of the things is the Dillon Brooks Cup for aspiring basketball players, young basketball players. One of these is to get them closer and closer.

quotes.speaker: Dillon Brooks
quotes.summary_phrase: Dillon Brooks on his viral courtside moment during the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: I'm there sitting right under the goal. Funny thing about that is I never got notification.
quotes.quote: By chance that it was Game 4 and they were down 3-0, and I'm there sitting right under the goal. Funny thing about that is I never got notification on what tickets I wanted. They were free to me, so that villain clip was free to y'all.

quotes.speaker: Dillon Brooks
quotes.summary_phrase: Dillon Brooks on his goal to get 17 technical fouls
quotes.excerpt: My villain goal would probably be not to get 17 technical fouls in a season.
quotes.quote: My villain goal would probably be not to get 17 technical fouls in a season. We'll see if I can save them for the end. At least half of them are earned. Some of them are by the same refs, and some of them I don't need to get. Costs me some wins. So, you know, it's the energy that we live by, so some of them are called for.

quotes.speaker: Dillon Brooks
quotes.summary_phrase: Dillon Brooks defines what makes a villain
quotes.excerpt: You just got to have a dog in you for the villain. You just got to not care.
quotes.quote: You just got to have a dog in you for the villain. You just got to not care what people say. You got to be a little, a little mean, you got to be a little, a little grungy. And you see, like I said, you just got to, you don't give a fuck about what anybody's got to say. When my career is all said and done, the villain is going to win at the end of the story.

quotes.speaker: Dillon Brooks
quotes.summary_phrase: Dillon Brooks on finding the edge in basketball
quotes.excerpt: He'll find something that, you know, that just gets you a little mad or a little in your feelings.
quotes.quote: Trying to find that edge, and he's really good at it. He always finds that edge with everybody. No matter who you are, he might not even know you, but he'll find something that, you know, that just gets you a little mad or a little in your feelings.

quotes.speaker: Dillon Brooks
quotes.summary_phrase: Dillon Brooks recalls being hazed as a junior player
quotes.excerpt: I remember like at the end of school I'd be trying to find a place in this school.
quotes.quote: I remember like at the end of school I'd be trying to find a place in this school just to chill and wait till these guys go to practice so I can just wait until my practice starts. But there was a couple days where they end up finding me, beating me up, stomping me, all kinds, you know, toughening me up for sure. And it gave me that, that little edge that I needed.

quotes.speaker: Dillon Brooks

quotes.excerpt: This is the first jewelry piece I bought from the jeweler right here himself.
quotes.quote: This is the first jewelry piece I bought from the jeweler right here himself. My daughter's name right here, Mila, and M.A. We'll leave that one for up, up for debate.

quotes.speaker: Dillon Brooks
quotes.summary_phrase: Dillon Brooks on his plan for a new concoction
quotes.excerpt: We're soon enough about to be doing a new concoction, just start dispersing in every single restaurant.
quotes.quote: We're soon enough about to be doing a new concoction, just start dispersing in every single restaurant, all the villains, or double V. Is it going to be the villain or the vigilante? You got to pick one.
